about.title: About
about.description: Pocket is a personal finance tracker built around one idea: tracking your money should take seconds, not minutes. Snap a receipt, categorize it, and move on. No spreadsheets, no manual data entry.

howItWorks.title: How It
howItWorks.step1Desc: Create your free account in seconds — no credit card needed
howItWorks.step2Desc: Type it in or snap a receipt — AI fills in the merchant, amount, and date
howItWorks.step3Desc: Organize entries by category — budgets and goals update automatically
howItWorks.step4Desc: See your health score, anomaly alerts, and spending trends in real-time
howItWorks.step5Desc: Ask your AI coach why you're over budget — it knows your actual numbers

features.title: Everything You
features.feature1Desc: Log income and expenses, organize by category, set budgets and savings goals. Your financial health score updates in real-time as you track.
features.feature2Desc: Snap a photo or upload a PDF — AI extracts merchant, amount, and date automatically. No more manual entry for receipts. Available on Pro.
features.feature3Desc: Ask questions about your own finances and get specific, data-backed answers. Not generic advice — answers based on your actual spending. Available on Pro.

faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.a1: Pro (€2.99/month) includes 10 receipt scans per month, an AI Budget Coach you can chat with about your own spending, an AI-generated monthly digest, a 90-day cash flow forecast, and unlimited transactions, budgets, goals, and accounts.
faq.a2: Yes. All data is stored encrypted in Firebase and transmitted over HTTPS. We never sell your data or share it with third parties.
faq.q3: Can I use Pocket on mobile?
faq.a3: Yes. Pocket is an installable PWA — add it to your home screen directly from the browser. No app store needed, works on iOS and Android.
faq.q4: What are the free plan limits?
faq.a4: Free includes 50 transactions/month, 3 budgets, 2 savings goals, 1 savings account, 3 recurring transactions, a financial health score, anomaly alerts, and 3 receipt scans/month as a teaser. Upgrade to Pro for €2.99/month to remove all limits and unlock the AI coach.
